changeSet.author: hellodata
changeSet.comment: Comment permissions used to be granted by default (READ) to every user with a non-NONE role in a data domain. Since only administrators get comment access by default now, revoke the read flag from all non-admin users. Only rows that carry read access alone are touched - a user who was explicitly granted write or review access keeps their permissions, and admins (HELLODATA_ADMIN, BUSINESS_DOMAIN_ADMIN portal-wide, DATA_DOMAIN_ADMIN per data domain) are left untouched.

update.where: read_comments = true AND write_comments = false AND review_comments = false AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_portal_role upr JOIN portal_role pr ON pr.id = upr.portal_role_id WHERE upr.user_id = dashboard_comment_permission.user_id AND pr.name IN ('HELLODATA_ADMIN', 'BUSINESS_DOMAIN_ADMIN') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_context_role ucr JOIN role r ON r.id = ucr.role_id WHERE ucr.user_id = dashboard_comment_permission.user_id AND ucr.context_key = dashboard_comment_permission.context_key AND r.name = 'DATA_DOMAIN_ADMIN' )
